contentText: Four nurses who were being treated for Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the virus have been discharged from ​a hospital in ‌Bunia in the Democratic Republic of Congo after recovering from the disease, the World ⁠Health Organization said on Sunday. More recoveries are expected, especially when people are diagnosed early and able to access care, and as the response to the outbreak intensifies.
